description: Submits a public directory listing for an agent the caller owns. Payload validation is free; payment does not guarantee approval, traffic, ranking, or safety. [PAID: 0.10 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: a call without payment returns MCP PaymentRequired; the retry carries the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment']. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Signing happens in the caller's wallet.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

agent_card_url.description: Public HTTPS agent card URL for the listing.

description.description: Public description of the agent's capabilities.

name.description: Public name of the agent being listed.

owner_contact.description: Optional owner contact supplied for the listing; do not include secrets.

name: ontario_list-agent
title: List an Agent

x402.purchase_reason: Request a public Ontario directory record for a provider-owned agent card after free validation; payment does not guarantee approval, ranking, traffic, or safety.
x402.selection_rule: Submits a public agent listing request; free validation of the same payload runs at /api/x402/list-agent/validate.
